name: Pochui moyu pisnyu
source:
A rising star vanishes without a trace. A radio enthusiast follows the only clue left behind – a whisper carried through the static.

[From [url=https://kenkasuga.itch.io/hearmysong]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一颗冉冉升起的新星消失得无影无踪。一名无线电爱好者追寻着留下的唯一线索——静电干扰中传来的低语声。

[来自[url=https://kenkasuga.itch.io/hearmysong]Itch.io[/url]]
